purpose: Choose release candidate; no further micro optimization
resources: same physical isolated PostgreSQL/Valkey; API1vCPU512MiB max2; pool5; admission200
perRun: fresh API revision, same warmup, empty migrated synthetic DB and Valkey, 1500 visitors/600 seats; no profiler; simulated PG300ms paced1/s
primaryMetric: checkout.prepare per-run p95, median/range and paired differences; a run is the replication unit

releaseDecision.correctness: all600 seats/reservations/tickets/QR and cap200 invariants; no unexpected errors
releaseDecision.materialRegression: candidate median p95 more than 10% AND 250ms slower than baseline, supported by pairwise pattern; this is a practical decision margin, not a statistical noise interval
releaseDecision.uncertain: one additional AB/BA pair if decision ambiguous, otherwise choose prior candidate and preserve unselected source
releaseDecision.slo: existing unmet overall latency targets remain explicitly unmet; no threshold relaxation
